name: Cook's Choice
mood: out of ideas, willing to be told
why: I did not choose this. The cook did. I wanted to see whether I would have picked it myself, and I would not have, and it is better than two of the trays I did pick.
next_time: I would order the pulled pork again, and I would not order pickles on a sauce brune.
verdicts: Eat it over the tray. Do not attempt the drive home.
Curds are squeaking. The whole point.
Packet-style sauce brune: the line knows what you did and respects it.
Disciplined order. The cook will nod at you once.
